Placeholder so the Aug 13 requirements don't get re-litigated. Emily cut this from Phase 1 and Kobi and Taryn re-confirmed Phase 2 on Aug 17. DO NOT BUILD.

=== FIELDS ===

* Suspended — Checkbox

* Suspended On — Date, automation-set

* Suspension Reason — Text

* Suspended By — Lookup(User), automation-set

* Suspension Source — Picklist: Salesforce; CMS

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* DESCOPE EVIDENCE. Joyce: 'Could we also push this deeper out to like after, like as like a launch?' Emily: 'so let's cut this for like, you know, next phase or whatever, next release.' Re-confirmed Aug 17 — Kobi: 'for suspended, we said we're going to table that for later, right?' Taryn: 'Phase two.'

* TARGET BEHAVIOUR, verbatim so it survives. One button, gated to 'a very high permission set'. On click: all associated Deals go Inactive, their links are removed from the CMS, and reps no longer see those operators on their landing pages. Existing sign-ups, queued redeposits and earned payouts are explicitly unaffected.

* Both directions must produce the same end state. Joyce: 'if it triggered on the CMS side, then it would just give you a heads up and then automatically deactivate all of the associated deals also and change the status. So either way, that button has to do that function.'

* Direction agreed, directionally only: originate in Salesforce, because CMS-to-SF deal updates don't exist — the CMS only sends back Deal Rep Assignments today. Joyce owed an internal decision: 'that's something that we just need to figure out internally and then we can get back to you.'

* Open when this resumes: does the Suspend button relabel to 'Reactivate' once suspended? The mockup didn't. And does the Deals related list actually show Inactive in the suspended state — the mockup's column looked blank.

=== NOTES ===

* Provenance: OP-5, OP-6, PT-6, PT-7 — all four stories collapse here.

* The Status picklist in BUILD-126/136 currently has only Active and Inactive. Suspended gets added when this resumes, and BUILD-147's automation will need a guard so it doesn't overwrite a suspended record.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc OP-5/OP-6/PT-6/PT-7

* Aug 13 call — Emily cut it

* Slack Kobi Aug 13 16:18

* Aug 17 call — re-confirmed Phase 2

Dependencies: Deal Status value set, CMS bidirectional sync

Owner (proposed): TBD

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.
